[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Charge Time/Range] "With Focusing Lens finished, Vorpal nerfed, and Firing Line fixed, Reed's Regret is the clear winner of the Legendary Linear Fusion War. Triple Tap/Firing Line is the usual play, with Clown/Vorpal or Triple/Vorpal being best for solo engagements. Accelerated/Liquid typically don't make too massive a change in overall DPS% (unless there's an encounter where you fully expend your ammo), and Enhanced Battery allows easier Triple Tap chaining / larger Clown Cartridge magazines." tags:god-pve

Inspired by DMB Player Versus Enemies Podcast 10. PvE first choice roll for Boss DPS. Barrel depends on your range/stability/handling preferences. Ionised Battery brings the magazine to seven, which gives you 10 shots from landing crits with Triple Tap, and 20% bonus damage in a fireteam from Firing Line. Even if you have it already, it's worth getting again for the Veist Stinger Origin Trait which gives you a chance for reloads when dealing damage, so you might get through all your reserves in a single phase without reloading. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with a damage-boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod.
